correctness.rationale: The centrally symmetric full-dimensional canonical Hansen twisted stable-set prism has centered maximal inball. Polar coordinates (t,x) satisfy |t+sum_(i in S)x_i|<=1 for all stable S. Splitting positive/negative supports gives ||x+||²<=(1-t)²mu, ||x-||²<=(1+t)²mu for mu=max_{p in Q(complement G)}||p||². Hence ||(t,x)||²<=t²+2(1+t²)mu<=1+4mu, with equality only t=±1; feasible endpoints (1,-2p) attain it, proving exact radius and all touching normals. For triangle-free graph F, p=1/2 feasible, mu>=n/4; Ramsey(3,9) 35-vertex F has alpha8, gives r<=1/6 <1/sqrt33, not claimed equality. Independent exact fractional Q vertex enumeration for K3, edgeless3 and C5 confirms mu=1,3,2. Random G(N,N^-3/4) with triangle deletion and alpha=o(n) proves unbounded ratio analytically.
residual_risks: The 35-vertex result is only a certified upper bound, not the exact inradius.
Graph family is existential; no explicit deterministic sequence claimed.

value.rationale: A universal inradius reduction to a natural fractional graph polytope and complete tangent-normal characterization are useful metric facts for arbitrary Hansen polytopes. The explicit unbounded breakdown of an already known perfect-graph clique formula shows that integrality is not a removable hypothesis, a structural counterexample rather than a tiny numerical gain.
